mapper.select: SELECT A.CATEGORY_NUM, CONVERT(A.BOARD_NUM, CHAR) AS BOARD_NUM, CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.TITLE) > 11 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(A.TITLE,1,11),"...") ELSE A.TITLE END AS TITLE, CASE WHEN A.CATEGORY_NUM between 200 and 299 THEN (SELECT CONCAT("/summernoteImage/", FILE_PATH, "/", FILE_NAME) FROM BOARD_MEDIAFILE_TEST MT1 WHERE I_BOARD_NUM = CONCAT(LPAD(A.CATEGORY_NUM, 5,'0'), A.BOARD_NUM) AND SEQ = (SELECT MIN(SEQ) FROM BOARD_MEDIAFILE_TEST MT2 WHERE MT1.I_BOARD_NUM = MT2.I_BOARD_NUM AND DELETED = 'N')) ELSE NULL END AS IMGPATH FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_NUM ORDER BY REGISTERED_DATE DESC) AS 'RN', CATEGORY_NUM, BOARD_NUM, TITLE, REGISTERED_DATE FROM BOARD_TEST WHERE CATEGORY_NUM IN (100, 303, 401, 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 500, 501, 502, 503) ) AS A WHERE A.RN <= 5
